phases_tested.phase1_notes: Discovery used internal API (api.amnhealthcare.io/ONEAmnJobSearch/v1/JobSearch). Successfully paginated 65+ pages collecting 6495+ Nursing jobs. Discovery works but did NOT apply Alabama state filter — returned jobs nationwide.
phases_tested.phase2_notes: Extraction was done via API response parsing (not Playwright/JSON-LD). Limited field set compared to full page extraction — many expected fields are missing because the API response doesn't include them.

src_url.notes: Points to API endpoint rather than job page, but acceptable as discovery source.

job_id.notes: Required field. Output has sequential 'id' (1,2,3...) but not actual job ID (e.g., 3504006). Job ID is parseable from the URL path.

location_city.notes: Required field. Combined 'location' field exists (e.g., 'Atlanta, GA') but city/state not split into separate fields.

location_state.notes: Required field. State is available in the combined 'location' field but not extracted separately.

location.notes: Filter violation: ALL 5 sample jobs are outside Alabama (GA, HI, KY, PA, SC). The scraper did not apply the required Alabama location filter to the API query.

posted_date.notes: All posted dates are within last 7 days (2026-07-09 to 2026-07-10). Date filter appears satisfied.

salary_min.notes: Optional field. Salary exists as combined string (e.g., '$1,981 - $2,082') but not parsed into min/max numbers.

salary_max.notes: Optional field. Same as salary_min — combined string not split.

employment_type.notes: Optional field. API response has 'job_type' (Travel) which differs from JSON-LD employmentType (TEMPORARY).

apply_url.notes: Optional field. Empty string for all items. Constructible from job_id: /apply/?jobIds={id}

specialty.notes: Optional field. Not available from API response.

company.notes: Field name differs from expected 'hiring_organization' but value is present.

issues.problem: Location filter not applied — all 5 sample jobs are outside Alabama (GA, HI, KY, PA, SC)
issues.details: Got: Atlanta, GA / Wailuku, HI / Lexington, KY / Erie, PA / Mount Pleasant, SC. Expected: All locations must be in Alabama per job filter requirements.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a location filter to the API query, e.g., Filters=Communities:Nursing AND States:AL or filter results in Python after collection.

issues.problem: Required field job_id is missing — output uses sequential 'id' (1,2,3...) instead of actual job ID
issues.details: Got: sequential id values 1-5. Expected: actual job IDs like '3504006', '3537334', etc. Job ID is parseable from URL path /job-details/{id}/.
issues.suggested_fix: Extract job_id from the URL field using regex: url_path.match(/job-details/(\d+)/) or use the API response's job ID field if available.

issues.problem: Required field location_city not extracted — only combined location string available
issues.details: Got: empty/missing. Expected: city name like 'Atlanta'. The combined 'location' field has 'Atlanta, GA' from which city can be parsed.
issues.suggested_fix: Parse the combined location field: city, state = location.split(', ') to populate location_city and location_state.

issues.problem: Required field location_state not extracted — only combined location string available
issues.details: Got: empty/missing. Expected: state code like 'GA'. Parseable from the combined 'location' field.
issues.suggested_fix: Parse the combined location field: city, state = location.split(', ') to populate location_city and location_state.

issues.problem: Optional field salary_min not extracted — salary only available as combined string
issues.details: Got: empty. Expected: numeric value like 1981. The 'salary' field has '$1,981 - $2,082' which can be parsed.
issues.suggested_fix: Parse salary string with regex: r'\$(\d[\d,]+)' to extract min and max values as numbers.

issues.problem: Optional field salary_max not extracted — salary only available as combined string
issues.details: Got: empty. Expected: numeric value like 2082. Same parsing fix as salary_min.
issues.suggested_fix: Parse salary string with regex to extract second dollar amount as max value.

issues.problem: Optional field apply_url is empty for all items
issues.details: Got: empty string. Expected: URL like 'https://www.amnhealthcare.com/apply/?jobIds=3504006'. Can be constructed from job_id.

issues.problem: Optional field employment_type not populated — API provides job_type which is different
issues.details: Got: empty. Expected: 'TEMPORARY' or similar. API has 'job_type': 'Travel' which is not the same as JSON-LD employmentType.
issues.suggested_fix: Either map 'Travel' job_type to employment_type, or add Phase 2 Playwright extraction to get the full JSON-LD employmentType field.

script_checks.execution_notes: Scraper ran successfully using internal API (not Playwright as product_analysis recommended). Discovery phase paginated 65+ pages collecting 6495+ jobs. Output limited to 5 samples via --sample flag. No crashes or errors.

remediation.reason: The scraper uses an internal API for discovery which works well, but it fails to: (1) apply the Alabama state filter to API queries, (2) extract job_id from URLs, (3) split the combined location field into city/state components, (4) parse salary string into numeric min/max. All mappings in product_analysis.json are tested:true with correct selectors — the issue is the scraper uses API extraction instead of page-level extraction and doesn't post-process the API data to populate required fields.

feedback_for_writer.summary: Discovery works well via the internal API — 6495+ jobs found across 65+ pages. However, 3 required fields are completely missing (job_id, location_city, location_state), and the Alabama location filter is not applied to any API queries. The salary data exists as a combined string but is not parsed into separate min/max numeric fields.

job_id.issue: Sequential 'id' (1,2,3) instead of actual job ID from URL
job_id.fix: Parse job_id from the URL field: job_id = re.search(r'/job-details/(\d+)/', url).group(1) or use the API response's job identifier field

location_city.issue: Required field not extracted — only combined location available
location_city.fix: Parse from combined location: parts = location.split(', '); location_city = parts[0].strip(); location_state = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else ''

location_state.issue: Required field not extracted — only combined location available
location_state.fix: Same as location_city — parse from combined location string

location_filter.issue: Alabama state filter not applied — all sample jobs are from other states (GA, HI, KY, PA, SC)
location_filter.fix: Add state filter to API query. Try adding 'States:AL' to the Filters parameter, e.g., Filters=Communities:Nursing,States:AL. If the API doesn't support state filtering, filter results in Python after collection: keep only where location_state == 'AL'.

salary_min.issue: Not parsed from combined salary string
salary_min.fix: Parse salary string: amounts = re.findall(r'\$([\d,]+)', salary); salary_min = int(amounts[0].replace(',', '')) if amounts else None

salary_max.issue: Not parsed from combined salary string
salary_max.fix: Parse salary string: amounts = re.findall(r'\$([\d,]+)', salary); salary_max = int(amounts[1].replace(',', '')) if len(amounts) > 1 else None

apply_url.issue: Empty for all items — not constructed from job_id
